candidates.next_action: If still wanted, obtain an official Monotype listing that actually shows a Condensed style before treating it as a candidate.

why_not_three: Only two candidates survive as live options. Bodoni MT is rejected on the mandate-specified authority, and no replacement was researched before the context budget ran out, so a third finalist is not asserted.

rendered_specimens_of_the_two_words.reason: Rendering "Rose" and "Damascena" in these faces requires the font binaries, which this execution is forbidden to download, and the official interactive specimen fields are JavaScript-driven and not reachable by the fetch tool. Substituting a lookalike face and presenting it as the candidate would be the exact failure this workstream has been removing, so no comparison imagery was fabricated.
